In [[mathematics]], the '''Siegel operator''' is a [[linear map]] from (level 1) [[Siegel modular form]]s of degree ''d'' to Siegel modular forms of degree&nbsp;''d''&nbsp;−&nbsp;1, generalizing taking the constant term of a [[modular form]]. The [[kernel (linear algebra)|kernel]] is the space of [[Siegel cusp form]]s of degree&nbsp;''d''.
